# Token Speed Simulator

> Browser-based LLM text-playback simulator for comparing perceived output speed from 1 to 2000 tokens per second. No model API is called during playback; it is not a live model benchmark.

## Start
- App: https://bubufu.com/tools/token-speed-simulator/en/
- Repository: https://github.com/jammyfu/TokenSpeedSimulator
- Run: npm ci && npm run dev; open http://localhost:3000/tools/token-speed-simulator/
- Playback needs no API key. Build: npm run build. Type-check: npm run lint.

## Reading guides
- English: https://github.com/jammyfu/TokenSpeedSimulator/blob/main/README.en.md
- 简体中文: https://github.com/jammyfu/TokenSpeedSimulator/blob/main/README.md

## Facts and limits
- Playback approximates 4 characters as 1 token; it is not a model tokenizer.
- A/B comparison uses the same source text. Markdown, source editing, model-family groups and light/dark themes are available.
- App locales: zh, zh-Hant, en, ja, ko, es, pt, ro, fr, de. Documentation covers five languages.
- Primary ranking snapshot: Artificial Analysis, 2026-10-12. Individual rows can have other dates and metrics, including OpenRouter p50 and vendor peaks. Do not conflate them or describe the data as current live rankings.
- Data definitions and row provenance: https://github.com/jammyfu/TokenSpeedSimulator/blob/main/src/data/modelSpeedRankings.ts
- Cost estimates cover simulated output only, not input/cache/reasoning charges or actual bills. Missing prices remain missing.
- URL fetching sends the target URL to a fetch endpoint and may fall back to Jina Reader. Do not submit private links or sensitive parameters.
- No repository LICENSE is currently present. Do not infer MIT or commercial reuse permission.
